name: Sovereign Ophidian Gaze
description: Petrify up to five visible foes in a 60-degree forward cone within 24 blocks for 30 seconds. Repeated casts extend petrification up to 60 seconds. Direction keys break free faster; pumpkin protection and Unstoppable remain effective. No cooldown or charge restriction. Player targets respect server PvP and team friendly-fire protections; rank/nameplate team membership alone does not grant immunity.
